scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
One shot.
One kill.
It's not so hard
once you develop the
vision for that style
of battling.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
一枪。
一命。
一旦你培养出
这种战斗风格的
视野，
其实并不难。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
The world is in
need of mighty Bowmen
like you. Are you ready for
the awesome responsibility?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
世界需要
像你这样强大的弓箭手。
你准备好迎接
这份伟大的责任了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Are you willing to
take the next step and
become a Sniper?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你愿意迈出下一步，
成为一名神射手吗？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
当你准备好的时候，
随时欢迎回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回来之前
用完你剩余的所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Congratulations!
As a Sniper, I hope
that the minions of evil
will never be safe so
long as they are in
your sight!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜！
作为一名神射手，我希望
邪恶的爪牙
只要在你的视野中，
就永远不得安宁！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
欢迎来到
英灵殿，
荣耀之厅。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
请在这里
随意休息。
向勇士们致敬！
